description: Data source of the directional survey. The ENV Phantoms algorithm solves the problem of missing directional surveys by building synthetic directional surveys (phantoms) for wells missing in our coverage areas. Given a surface hole location (SHL), a bottom-hole location (BHL), a lateral length and a true vertical depth (TVD), a set of prospective phantoms can be drawn and assessed to determine which well path is most likely. name: ENVWellboreType
description: SINGLE BORE: Well that only has one wellbore. PILOT: Vertical wellbore on a multi-bore well that is deep enough to reach the target formation. It is not completed or produced. ORIGINAL: Vertical wellbore on a multi-bore well that has been completed or produced. SIDETRACK: Unintended wellbore segment that is usually caused by a mis steer during drilling. It is not completed or produced. LATERAL: The only horizontal wellbore on a multi-bore well that is permitted, completed or produced. MUTILATERAL: All horizontal wellbores on a multi-bore well that are permitted, completed or produced. UNDETERMINED: All the other wellbores on a multi-bore well that does not fall into above categories.These ENV Wellbore Types will be rolled out to each state over time, starting with Canada and Texas.

description: A survey is a certified measured description of a piece of land in Texas.

name: TestComments
description: Comments related to the tests.

name: TestDate

name: Tortuosity
description: Ratio of the actual distance over the straight line distance of the wellbore.

description: Total number of clusters contained in the wellbore. A cluster is defined as a frac port, a sliding sleeve, or a perforating gun.

name: TotalFluidPumped_BBL
description: Barrels of fluid used to complete the well reported on the state completion document (bbl).

name: TotalOrganicCarbon_WTPCT

description: Total number of producing months for a given well

name: TotalShots

name: TotalWaterPumped_GAL
description: Total water volume used to complete the well (not water volume produced), reported in gallons (gal).

name: TotalWellCostHistorical_USDMM

name: Township

name: Trajectory
description: The most recent reported trajectory from state-disclosed production, completion or permit data. Enverus derives trajectory where state data is not available or incorrectly disclosed.

description: Costs associated with transporting oil, gas and NGLs from wellhead to local hub. RSEG uses company disclosures at the play level to create a regression of transport cost versus wellhead liquid % and applies this on a well-by-well basis.
